scope: Fresh source-only experiment-bridge Phase 2.5 review of the exact complete-ABC B416 budgeted/pairwise runner, real-fit CPU auditor and plan; no actual runtime acceptance

checks.result: Current trainer and model bytes match the existing accepted module-freeze staging identities exactly: trainer f1089cf0d8e8ebbc2d1f83ac60bff0267edd4aa6c1c3c717829393e4d7622474 and model 082945bc2742c046dc75439ec41e2d37e209974d4afc72a8f1cbb5b096824aaa. The new auditor equals the accepted freeze auditor after only the intended path, arm, replay-ranking and interpretation substitutions. Existing source/parent checks remain intact; no production edit or new binding scheme was introduced.

Both arms use complete ABC with an empty frozen-modules list, frozen C1, the same protected old4 initialization, own902 TRAIN/128 validation cache, seed42, B416, oracle search supervision and action write verification. Parser execution confirms lr and weight decay 1e-4, threshold .03, no pair calibration and no prefer-last-prefix behavior. The two command configurations differ only in action_ranking and output. Three optimizer steps per epoch give M0 3 epochs/9 updates and full 60 epochs/180 updates. GPU0/3 are recorded in the plan; actual device availability and caller assignments remain deployment responsibilities.

The paired-cache and same-family provisional source-review receipts are checked before training. Full requires the actual both-ranking-arms M0 acceptance with B416, 3 epochs and 9 updates per arm. Literal execution accepts valid receipts and rejects missing receipts or each incorrect required field. A source-only PASS does not satisfy the M0 gate. Existing output directories prevent a repeated run; private cwd/PYTHONPATH and explicit import-path assertions bind training to the new private source. Completion markers are written only after successful training, and the runner starts no 98-video evaluation.

Private source, review, staging, M0 acceptance, full-audit and both stage/arm output paths are consistently renamed to joint_b416. The CPU auditor keeps empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES/private-cwd/import-path checks, CPU tensor loading, disabled autograd, CUDA-uninitialized assertions, the exact protected-parent identity, and before/after verification of the existing staging source map. The unchanged same-parent 25-state-tensor and eight-C1-tensor checks are retained.

Both the initial-parent and selected-best CPU evaluations pass the actual variant into replay, which explicitly supplies action_ranking=ranking. The audit also requires cfg.action_ranking to equal that variant. The complete 128-query validation job order, matching initial/best metrics and all 21 saved arrays remain checked, with exact integer/boolean equality and the established float32-epsilon float tolerance. This is CPU replay through the accepted evaluator, not an independent metric implementation.

Both empty frozen lists make A/B/C active. The auditor requires all three parameter counts, actual expected logs and optimizer totals, finite positive recorded module gradients, positive maximum gradients, and terminal modules_changed for every group. It retains exact cache/config/job provenance checks, disjoint 881/98 sequence partitions, own-policy epoch25 prefixes, the same C1 head and 902/128 cached queries. Final acceptance is written only after both arms and the concluding source/parent checks pass.

The trainer saves epoch0 before updates and replaces best only on strictly greater utility. The auditor selects the first maximum over the full epoch history and checks selected/last metrics and checkpoint arguments. Best0 must remain exactly the parent across ABC and C1; nonzero selected best must show changes in each active ABC group. Terminal update claims come from source-linked receipts/logs computed before best reload, while selected-best tensor differences are measured separately. The record explicitly identifies best0 as parent initialization without claiming new learning.

No inference behavior changes. Only DECISION_FIELDS enter the model, those fields are disjoint from LABEL_FIELDS, and select_actions reads only decision fields. Budgeted versus pairwise changes the training ranking objective and corresponding evaluation loss; the deployed selector has no ranking-mode branch. Current/future dataset labels are used for supervision and cached evaluation after decisions, never for the action decision.
